item.title: Johnnie Walker toasts to African Music Excellence at Trace Awards 2025 - The Plug
item.description: A night of music excellence, the Trace Awards 2025 were held in Zanzibar this week. We give you the rundown of what took place at the show.

item.title: Artclub and Friends teams up with Mr. Price for new release - The Plug
item.description: Artclub and friends have teamed up with Mr. Price for a new research collection merging street style with artistic flair.

item.title: Johnnie Walker toasts to TitoM and Yuppe after Song of the Year win for Tshwala Bam - The Plug
item.description: TitoM and Yuppe take the Song of the Year at the 2025 Trace Music Awards for "Tshwala Bam." We had a chat with the duo on their successes.

item.title: Castle Lite Unlocks is back and they’re bringing Travis Scott along with them - The Plug
item.description: Travis Scott makes a return to SA with the extension of his Circus Maximus Tour, for the second wind of Castle Lite Unlocks.

item.title: Doja Cat is bringing her brand of boldness to Hey Neighbour - The Plug
item.description: Doja Cat is the first confirmed headliner for this year's Hey Neighbour festival, bringing her versatility and boldness to the festival.

item.title: Johnnie Walker Celebrates TitoM & Yuppe With $15,000 Cheque For Song Of The Year At The Trace Awards - The Plug
item.description: TitoM and Yuppe were presented with a cheque for $15,000 by Johnnie Walker after their Song of the Year win at the Trace Awards.

item.title: H&M celebrates 10 years in South Africa with their S/S25 music experience - The Plug
item.description: H&M's celebration of the brand's ten year anniversary in South Africa was an immersive experience of music, fashion, and culture.

item.title: DJ Lag and Ape Drums (of Major Lazer) release new track "GQTech" - The Plug
item.description: DJ Lag and Ape Drums have a banger on their hands with their new single 'GQTech" that fuses gqom and Afro tech.

item.title: Travis Scott's Circus Maximus tour hit South African shores and it was nothing short of electric - The Plug
item.description: Travis Scott left the crowd in awe as the performed "FE!N" six times and broke down into tears during his South African show.
